sentences.zh: 所以我们想请你讲讲那个故事，那个你正在车里报道的故事，关于我们是如何走到这一步的：总统

sentences.en: So this has been an issue that's been kind of building for quite a while in California.

sentences.en: There have been periodic immigration enforcement actions around the state.

sentences.en: But in Los Angeles, it really came to a head at the end of last week, on a Friday in a part of Los Angeles that is very dense and very busy.

sentences.en: And they showed up to start arresting people who had been deported once already, but who they believed had come back.

sentences.en: Got it.

sentences.en: That's right.

sentences.en: So federal agents come into this clothing wholesaler at about 1.30 in the afternoon, and they show up and they start detaining people, you know, employees inside this business,
sentences.zh: 联邦特工在下午1点半左右进入这家服装批发商，他们出现并开始拘留人，你知道，就是这家企业里的员工，

sentences.en: And people inevitably in this cramped, closed space start to freak out and make phone calls, and word gets out.

sentences.en: government code that allows him to summon the National Guard to see to it that federal authorities are able to conduct the people's business without interference.

sentences.zh: 而且总统即将废掉马斯克选择的 NASA 负责人，这是政府中对马斯克最重要的机构。

sentences.en: And that wounded Elon Musk is the person who leaves the White House and starts this feud.
sentences.zh: 而那个受伤的埃隆·马斯克就是离开白宫并开始这场争斗的人。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And you have this effort from people close to Trump to say that this is all self-interest from Musk.
sentences.zh: 特朗普身边的人试图说这一切都是马斯克出于个人利益。

sentences.en: Musk, it's really because the big, beautiful bill got rid of subsidies for electric vehicles.
sentences.zh: 马斯克，这确实是因为那项“宏大而美妙的法案”取消了电动汽车的补贴。

sentences.en: And I'm sure there's some truth to him being irritated about the way that they handled electric vehicle subsidies.
sentences.zh: 我相信他对他们处理电动汽车补贴的方式感到恼火是有一定道理的。

sentences.en: But what we found in our reporting is that the much more important reasons for this feud was
sentences.zh: 但我们在报道中发现，这场争斗更重要的原因是

sentences.en: that Musk felt over a period of weeks that his work for Doge was being canceled out by their tax bill.
sentences.zh: 马斯克在几周的时间里感到他为 DOGE 所做的工作被他们的税收法案抵消了。

sentences.en: And what you saw in the next few days is Musk moving in his public commentary on X from
sentences.zh: 你在接下来的几天里看到的是，马斯克在 X 上的公开评论从

sentences.en: criticizing the legislation, you know, calling it a disgusting abomination to attacking Trump personally.
sentences.zh: 批评立法，你知道，称其为“令人作呕的怪物”，转变为对特朗普进行人身攻击。

sentences.en: Over or entering a very different stage of itself that's deeply diminished.
sentences.zh: 或者说进入了一个非常不同的阶段，其自身价值已大幅缩水。

sentences.en: Who has, based on your reporting, more to lose from it being over?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，谁从这段关系的结束中损失更大？

sentences.en: Which I guess is another way of asking which of these men, the president or the world's richest man, has greater leverage over the other?
sentences.zh: 我想这是问这两个人中，总统还是世界上最富有的人，谁对另一方拥有更大的筹码的另一种方式？

sentences.en: I will answer that question, but I think it's really important to take a slight step back and just understand that Trump doesn't have normal human relationships.
sentences.zh: 我会回答这个问题，但我认为退后一步理解特朗普并没有正常的人际关系非常重要。

sentences.en: He is transactional.
sentences.zh: 他是交易型的。

sentences.en: If he can see value in somebody, if he could see that someone could do something for him,
sentences.zh: 如果他能看到某人的价值，如果他能看出某人能为他做些什么，

sentences.en: Donald Trump is always open to some form of reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总是对某种形式的和解持开放态度。

sentences.en: I flew with Trump on Air Force One on Friday afternoon to New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 周五下午，我随特朗普乘坐空军一号前往新泽西州。

sentences.en: On the flight, I asked Trump about Musk.
sentences.zh: 在飞行途中，我问了特朗普关于马斯克的问题。

sentences.en: I said to him, you posted on True Social the other day that a great way to save money for
sentences.zh: 我对他说，你前几天在“真实社交”（Truth Social）上发帖说，为

sentences.en: the federal government would be to cancel Elon Musk's billions of dollars worth of contracts with the federal government.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府省钱的一个好方法是取消埃隆·马斯克与联邦政府价值数十亿美元的合同。

sentences.en: I said, how seriously did you take that?
sentences.zh: 我说，你对此有多认真？

sentences.en: And Trump said, well, you know, we're going to look at it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，嗯，你知道，我们会看看的。

sentences.en: We're going to look at everything.
sentences.zh: 我们会审视一切。

sentences.en: You know, he's got a lot of subsidy, gets a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他有很多补贴，拿了很多钱。

sentences.en: Then he goes, but I'm only going to do it if it's fair, you know, and it was this sort of like, nice companies you've got there.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，但我只有在公平的情况下才会这么做，你知道，这就像是说，你那里的公司不错，

sentences.en: It'd be a shame if something would happen to them.
sentences.zh: 如果发生点什么事就太可惜了。

sentences.en: So Trump very well understands.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普非常清楚。

sentences.en: That's his leverage.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的筹码。

sentences.en: Of course, he has the power to inflict extreme harm on Musk's businesses, which have a huge amount of exposure to the federal government, in particular SpaceX.
sentences.zh: 当然，他有权对马斯克的企业造成极大的伤害，这些企业在很大程度上依赖于联邦政府，特别是 SpaceX。

sentences.en: I mean, we've seen that Donald Trump is willing to use the levers of federal power to go after his enemies, whether it be law firms, Harvard University, you know, go down the liSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们已经看到唐纳德·特朗普愿意利用联邦权力的杠杆去对付他的敌人，无论是律师事务所、哈佛大学，还是其他名单上的机构。

sentences.en: So everyone, including Elon Musk, presumably knows that this threat is real.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人，包括埃隆·马斯克，大概都知道这种威胁是真实的。

sentences.en: So that's Trump's leverage.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普的筹码。

sentences.en: I think that leverage exceeds any leverage that Elon Musk has.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种筹码超过了埃隆·马斯克所拥有的任何筹码。

sentences.en: But people close to Trump are aware that Musk is not without leverage.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普身边的人也意识到，马斯克并非没有筹码。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, you can tick through the obvious stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以列举出一些显而易见的事情。

sentences.en: He's the richest guy in the world.
sentences.zh: 他是世界上最富有的人。

sentences.en: He's, you know, the biggest donor in Republican politics.
sentences.zh: 他也是共和党政治中最大的捐款人。

sentences.en: But there's also another thing which people don't talk about so much in public, but they'll certainly talk about privately, which is he's seen a lot.
sentences.zh: 但还有一点，人们在公开场合谈论得不多，但在私下里肯定会谈到，那就是他见多识广。

sentences.en: He has been allowed into a lot of rooMs.
sentences.zh: 他获准进入过许多会议室。

sentences.en: He had a lot of exposure to very sensitive conversations.
sentences.zh: 他接触过许多非常敏感的谈话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So people close to Trump think that this probably ends up in some form of a transactional truce.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普身边的人认为，这最终可能会达成某种形式的交易式休战。

sentences.en: They're not going to have this best buddy bromance type relationship that they had before.
sentences.zh: 他们不会再有以前那种好哥们儿般的亲密关系了。

sentences.en: But I wouldn't be surprised if they come to some form of an agreement where they don't attack each other personally.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们达成某种互不进行人身攻击的协议，我也不会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I don't know if there's a financial component to this.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这其中是否涉及经济成分。

sentences.en: I mean, Musk had already promised Trump that he would give $100 million to his outside groups ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，马斯克此前已经向特朗普承诺，在2026年中期选举前，他会向特朗普的外部团体捐赠1亿美元。

sentences.en: He hasn't given that money yet.
sentences.zh: 他还没给这笔钱。

sentences.en: So does Donald Trump say, guess what?
sentences.zh: 那么唐纳德·特朗普会不会说，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: The price just went up?
sentences.zh: 价格刚涨了？

sentences.en: I don't know whether he will, but he's done similar things before, making people pay a price for peace.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他会不会这么做，但他以前做过类似的事情，让人们为和平付出代价。

sentences.en: But this is the state of where we're at with these relationships and also with Trump's exercise of power in his second term.
sentences.zh: 但这正是我们目前在这些关系以及特朗普在第二任期行使权力方面所处的现状。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in that way, Jonathan, this doesn't seem entirely unrelated thematically to what is happening right now in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，乔纳森，这在主题上似乎与洛杉矶目前发生的事情并非完全无关。

sentences.en: Obviously, these are very different situations.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是两种截然不同的情况。

sentences.en: But I'm thinking about the word power you just used and Trump's projections of power over the past couple of days.
sentences.zh: 但我正在思考你刚才用的“权力”这个词，以及特朗普过去几天展现出的权力投射。

sentences.en: Look, I think what you're seeing in both these instances is the improvised nature of Trump's government.
sentences.zh: 听着，我认为你在两起事件中看到的都是特朗普政府即兴发挥的本质。

sentences.en: This is one man making decisions very quickly with not really much of a process behind it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个男人在没有太多流程支持的情况下，非常迅速地做出决定。

sentences.en: You know, Elon Musk asks him to run this thing called Doge.
sentences.zh: 你知道，埃隆·马斯克让他负责管理这个叫“Doge”的部门。

sentences.en: Trump says, sure, go for it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，没问题，放手去做吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we still don't know exactly what happened behind the scenes with this deployment of the National Guard, but we certainly know it wasn't a normal process.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然不知道这次国民警卫队的部署背后究竟发生了什么，但我们肯定知道这不是一个正常的流程。

sentences.en: And he's doing it over the objections of the state's governor, Gavin Newsom.
sentences.zh: 而且他是在无视该州州长加文·纽森反对的情况下这么做的。

sentences.en: So what we see in both these instances is one man exercising tremendous power with very limited and eroded checks on that power without any real form of an interagency process.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在两起事件中看到的是，一个人在对权力的制衡极其有限且被削弱的情况下，在没有任何真正的跨部门流程的情况下，行使着巨大的权力。

sentences.en: So you have high risk, high speed, and a lot of cars colliding.
sentences.zh: 所以你面临的是高风险、高速度，以及大量的碰撞。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The White House, which spent months fighting legal orders to return a man it mistakenly deported to a prison in El Salvador, has returned him to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 白宫此前花费数月时间对抗法律命令，拒绝将一名被误遣返回萨尔瓦多监狱的男子送回，如今已将其送回美国。

sentences.en: Kilmar Abrego-Garcia was flown back on Friday, ending the administration's most high-profile battle with federal courts over the president's immigration policies.
sentences.zh: 基尔马·阿布雷戈-加西亚已于周五乘机返回，这标志着政府与联邦法院之间关于总统移民政策最引人注目的斗争告一段落。
zh_words: 基尔马·阿布雷戈-加西亚

sentences.en: Abrego-Garcia has landed in the United States to face justice.
sentences.zh: 阿布雷戈-加西亚已抵达美国，等待接受审判。

sentences.en: During a news conference, Attorney General Pam Bondi said that Abrego-Garcia now faces
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，司法部长帕姆·邦迪表示，阿布雷戈-加西亚现在面临

sentences.en: federal charges of illegally transporting undocumented migrants, but it's unclear whether the government has strong evidence to prove that claim.
sentences.zh: 非法运送无证移民的联邦指控，但目前尚不清楚政府是否有强有力的证据来证明这一指控。

sentences.en: Upon completion of a sentence, we anticipate he will be returned to his home country of El
sentences.zh: 我们预计，在他服刑期满后，他将被遣返回他的祖国萨尔

sentences.en: Salvador.
sentences.zh: 瓦多。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗谢尔·邦贾、戴安娜·阮、埃里克·克鲁普克和亚历克斯·斯特恩制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Diao, contains original music by Rowan Nemisto, Sophia Landman, Pat
sentences.zh: 由莱克西·迪奥剪辑，包含罗文·内米斯托、索菲亚·兰德曼、帕特·

sentences.en: McCusker, Marion Lozano, and Diane Wong, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 麦卡斯克、马里昂·洛扎诺和黛安·王创作的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢埃菲姆·夏皮罗。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bilbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·比尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
